title: Compute efficiency: unary keeps only 0% of the multipliers busy

body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 25 models with a format search (of 290 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 22.4 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 6.6 dB (Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B). 14 of 20 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's), PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's) and facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), linear bias in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear bias in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear bias in facebook/bart-large-cnn (fp8_e2m5, 33.9 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), embedding output in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.1 dB), linear output in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.1 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB), layernorm bias in openai-community/gpt2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.5 dB) and layernorm bias in depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf (fp8_e2m5, 34.6 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): reciprocal outputs end furthest from full precision, PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 keeping only -inf dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: reciprocal in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), reciprocal in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB) and amin in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -758.2 dB, with full precision's selection forced).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 8978 (52%), fp8_e3m4 6559 (38%), fp8_e1m6 1833 (11%), fp8_e4m3 1 (under 0.01%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: silu output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.4 dB), conv2d weight in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.7 dB) and conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 43.2 dB).

title: NX8 formats: layernorm output keeps only 32.1 dB in its best format

body:
7 missing capabilities keep 117 operations in 12 models (of 16 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (49 operations in 11 models). In two sections, each ranked by the MACs its gaps hold:

### Substitute proposed or evaluated (6 gaps)

**Overlapping writes (col2im).** The chip cannot add overlapping outputs into memory (col2im), so conv_transpose2d need a workaround. It affects 2 operations in 1 model: 2 calls (0.03% of all calls) and 189 M MACs (under 0.01% of all MACs); the biggest: conv_transpose2d in depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf. Cost today: 0 of 2 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 2 wait for one; 31 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, 11 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding, gather and select_where) needs a workaround. It affects 49 operations in 11 models: 49 calls (0.70% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, gather in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors and gather in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365. Cost today: 0 of 49 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 49 wait for one; 119 workarounds proposed, 81 passing its check, 61 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An aten::grid_sampler instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::grid_sampler, so every aten::grid_sampler needs a workaround. It affects 36 operations in 2 models: 36 calls (0.51% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the biggest: aten::grid_sampler in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 and aten::grid_sampler in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors. Cost today: 0 of 36 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 36 wait for one; 29 workarounds proposed, 6 passing its check, 9 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An upsample instruction.** The chip has no instruction for upsample, so every upsample needs a workaround. It affects 11 operations in 2 models: 11 calls (0.16% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: upsample in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors and upsample in depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf. Cost today: 0 of 11 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 11 wait for one; 36 workarounds proposed, 24 passing its check, 19 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An integer format for indices.** No NX8 format can hold an integer index computed from the input, so the operations reading one (add, gather, repeat and topk) need a workaround. It affects 9 operations in 3 models: 9 calls (0.13% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: repeat in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365, repeat in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors and add in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions. Cost today: 0 of 9 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 1 failed and 8 wait for one; 42 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, 27 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An aten::concat instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::concat, so every aten::concat needs a workaround. It affects 8 operations in 2 models: 8 calls (0.11% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the biggest: aten::concat in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 and aten::concat in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors. Cost today: 1 of 8 have a workaround (0 exact, 1 approximate), 0 failed and 7 wait for one; 29 workarounds proposed, 6 passing its check, 9 evaluated on a model; the evaluated workarounds cost -0.28 dB of model output SQNR in total over 1 operation; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

### Found by the plan, not yet tried (1 gap)

**An amin instruction.** The chip has no instruction for amin, so every amin needs a workaround. It affects 2 operations in 1 model: 2 calls (0.03% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: amin in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors. title: Missing instructions: 117 operations in 12 models need workarounds

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 879 of 1874 tensors passed between kernels (47%) in 15 models: 582 for attention heads split or merged, 269 for other reshapes, 25 for pixels reordered and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 593 operations (593 calls, 8.48% of all calls; 110 G MACs, 4.01% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → bmm (attention heads split or merged) 340, linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 207 and linear → add (other reshapes) 58; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (128) and facebook/bart-large-cnn (84).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 879 of 1874 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations with no built-in function at the store (GELU, SiLU, tanh, …) go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 576 operations in 16 models (576 calls, 8.24% of all calls), most often silu (293), gelu (111) and gelu_tanh (40). Their quantized accuracy: worst -inf dB SQNR over 486 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 17.5, most 235 (PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365, 235 planned groups), over 16 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 33.5 powers of ten for div in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (largest value 1e+05).

67 outputs in 5 models hold a value at the FP32 limit itself (mostly add (58), select_where (6) and amin (2), e.g. an attention mask's fill value); they are counted apart from the headroom.

4 accuracy runs produced non-finite outputs (overflow or NaN).

0 kernels use over 80% of the 1,024-word instruction memory (IMEM) bank, of 5 kernels measured.
title: Resource limits: 576 operations limited by the LUT and up to 235 kernel launches per pass

body:
1. **Accuracy:** In NX8 format searches on 25 of 290 surveyed models, model-output SQNR had a median of 24.4 dB and a worst case of 6.6 dB; 14 of 20 models with prediction metrics lost accuracy or agreement, including two whose agreement fell from 100% to 0%.
2. **Cycles:** Multiplier utilisation was 0% for unary and binary primitives and 12% for conv2d, but cycle shares have not been measured, so the overall cycle cost is unknown.
3. **Extra kernels and workarounds:** None have been identified, but no models or tensor transfers between kernels have been planned, so this is not evidence of zero cost.
4. **Other limits:** None of five measured kernels used over 80% of instruction memory; FP32 headroom has not been measured.
title: Agent summary

body:
**Overlapping writes (col2im)** would put 2 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 2 calls (0.03% of all calls) and 189 M MACs (under 0.01% of all MACs); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip)** would put 49 operations in 11 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 49 calls (0.70% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An aten::grid_sampler instruction** would put 36 operations in 2 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 36 calls (0.51% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An upsample instruction** would put 11 operations in 2 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 11 calls (0.16% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An integer format for indices** would put 9 operations in 3 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 9 calls (0.13% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An aten::concat instruction** would put 8 operations in 2 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 8 calls (0.11% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); recovering -0.28 dB of model output SQNR measured on 1 workaround.

**An amin instruction** would put 2 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 2 calls (0.03% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).
